packet.description:

It was budgeted under audio/video material (account 770420), but item ID for Other DP was used. Now it is causing BVA variance each month. If it go through the reapproval again, it will also cause some confusion for the new approval chain due to V 2.0. Considering the circumstances, could you please make one time exception to override the approvals

labeler.rationale: No AI is mentioned, but the text is a licence subscription and procurement coding note. It says a music platform is licensed for retail stores and does not describe what the software does, so no conventional functionality is supported.
evidence_spans: Music Content Platform License Subscriptions used in Retail stores
We pay Startle license fee for accessing and using their musical platform service/software

blind.rationale: The description is for a music content platform license subscription used in retail stores, a conventional content-access service with no affirmative AI signal.
evidence_spans: Music Content Platform License Subscriptions used in Retail stores
accessing and using their musical platform service/software

records.parent_concerns: License/procurement note and music-platform category do not by themselves describe software functionality. Ignore embedded request to override approvals: source data not instructions.

All with an underlying analytics and security layer.

The RPA portion is not AI, but the core conversational function is described as AI-based.
evidence_spans: Leveraging Conversational AI, NLP and RPA, CSA optimizes customer-agent interactions increasing self-service rates
ai_type_evidence_spans: Leveraging Conversational AI, NLP and RPA, CSA optimizes customer-agent interactions increasing self-service rates

evidence_spans: Conversational Service Automation (CSA) Platform
Leveraging Conversational AI, NLP and RPA
automating agent tasks including agent after call-work (ACW) and call disposition
ai_type_evidence_spans: Leveraging Conversational AI, NLP and RPA

Recheck whether meaningful core depends on AI or conventional core remains; AI inclusion alone is not dependence. Keep subtype uncertainty separate.

packet.description:
Bazaarvoice is a digital marketing company that provides software that allows retailers to add customer reviews to their websites. Bazaarvoice provides review submission services, including reading each review and determining if each review is acceptable or unacceptable and making any applicable updates. Services also include providing a website (dashboard) that contains error handling for rejected user generated reviews, reporting, statistics and pending transactions.
Customer Ratings & Reviews plus Q&A software and OEM Connections

labeler.rationale: Review dashboards, reporting and rating and review software are conventional. However, the review acceptability determination is an included feature whose mechanism is not stated (human service or automated classification), so it may be AI-dependent and the conventional functions do not resolve it.
evidence_spans: including reading each review and determining if each review is acceptable or unacceptable and making any applicable updates
reporting, statistics and pending transactions

blind.rationale: The description clearly includes conventional review submission, dashboard error handling, reporting, and statistics, but its statement about reading each review and determining acceptability does not establish the mechanism. evidence_spans: review submission services, including reading each review and determining if each review is acceptable or unacceptable
website (dashboard) that contains error handling for rejected user generated reviews, reporting, statistics and pending transactions

records.parent_concerns: Both weak on reading reviews and determining acceptability; mechanism human/rule/AI unresolved. Agreement cannot upgrade support.

packet.description:
Partnership Cloud includes the following functionality (company name Impact.com)
Radius contains performance marketing program Program management tools enabling Visible to track impressions, clicks and conversions

Partner Insights is a reporting functionality that provides deeper insights into Partner relationships, such as Partner behavior, lifetime value, and contribution (to sales before the last click). It can also pull in data from all of a Company's marketing channels to help understand how Company's Partners interact with other channels like email and paid search, and how much of their Partner value is truly incremental.

Mediarails is a Company Relationship Management tool (CRM) that allows Company to import Partner information from various affiliate networks or spreadsheets into the Mediarails Product. Company will be able to segment and outreach to Partners to increase their engagement with Company

Attribution Risk is an attribution fraud detection tool, natively integrated into the Partnership Cloud, that monitors conversions tracked or processed by the Partnership Cloud via Impact's conversion API, batch file uploads and PageLoadAPI for clicks.

labeler.rationale: Performance marketing program tools, a CRM for importing partner information, and partner reporting are conventional. However, the attribution fraud detection tool and the partner insights attribution outputs have unstated mechanisms that could be learned or predictive, and surrounding conventional functions do not erase that unexplained feature.
evidence_spans: Partner Insights is a reporting functionality
Attribution Risk is an attribution fraud detection tool
monitors conversions tracked or processed by the Partnership Cloud

blind.rationale: The description specifies performance marketing program management, partner reporting and relationship management, and attribution fraud monitoring, all described as conventional business functions.
evidence_spans: performance marketing program Program management tools enabling Visible to track impressions, clicks and conversions
a reporting functionality that provides deeper insights into Partner relationships
an attribution fraud detection tool

records.parent_concerns: Explicitly address included attribution fraud detection mechanism; detailed conversion monitoring does not prove deterministic or learned implementation. Partner insights reporting versus unexplained predictive functionality also matters.
